strings.faq.title: Questions you wanted to ask
strings.faq.a0: The services section shows starting prices: Instagram from $550, TikTok from $500, paid ads and websites from $350, chatbots and consulting on request. We name the final amount after the brief: it depends on the scope and the niche. If the full package is out of reach, we'll find a format that fits. We state the final amount once, with no hidden fees.
strings.faq.a1: We recommend from $10 a day. How much you need exactly, we'll work out together after your request. You pay the ad budget separately from our services, directly into the ad account.
strings.faq.a2: No. We state the final amount right away.
strings.faq.a3: No, and here's why. Marketing brings you people who are interested. But they buy from you: a lot depends on sales, service, price and the product. Anyone who guarantees results either doesn't understand how it all works or is selling a fairy tale. We guarantee what depends on us: tests, quick changes, transparent numbers. If something doesn't work, we'll be the first to tell you why, even when the problem isn't the ads.
strings.faq.q4: What will I get in the first month?
strings.faq.a4: It depends on the package you choose. Visual changes show up in the first month. On the call we'll tell you what to expect in your case.
strings.faq.q5: How will I know it's working?
strings.faq.a5: We send reports daily or monthly, depending on the service. With paid ads, daily reports are a must.
strings.faq.a6: Of course. We take your wishes into account, and if we did something differently, we explain why.
strings.faq.q7: What do you need from me at the start?
strings.faq.a7: Answers to our questions, so we can get into the project quickly and effectively while you spend as little time as possible.
strings.faq.q8: Won't you take on my competitor?
strings.faq.a8: No. It's written into the contract. We don't work with two businesses in the same niche in the same city.
strings.faq.a9: Yes. The minimum term is 1 month.
strings.faq.q10: Who owns the accounts, campaigns and content?
strings.faq.a10: You do. The copyright passes to you, and the content and campaigns stay with you, even if we stop working together.
strings.faq.q11: How do I end the cooperation?
strings.faq.a11: Give us 14 days' notice. You'll receive everything that was made while we worked together.
strings.faq.q12: Can I take only paid ads or only SMM?
strings.faq.a12: Yes. You can take them separately or everything as a package.
strings.faq.q13: How are you different from other agencies?
strings.faq.a13: Our team is made up of specialists in their own fields. And we're flexible: we tried, it didn't work, we changed it, we scaled it. We even tailor our service packages to your results.
strings.faq.q14: Who will work on my project?
strings.faq.a14: The specialist responsible for your area: SMM, paid ads, website or chatbot.
strings.faq.q15: How often will we be in touch?
strings.faq.a15: We work Monday to Friday, 10:00 to 18:00. But we can't help replying to a meme on a Saturday night 😄
strings.faq.q16: How much of my time does it take?
strings.faq.a16: Not much. We take care of everything, from the idea to the launch. You need to answer our questions and approve the content and ad decisions. We do the rest.
strings.faq.q17: Which niches don't you work with?
strings.faq.a17: We don't take projects that promise “quick money”, grey schemes or products that don't pass ad platform moderation. And we don't take a second client in the same niche and city. If we don't believe in a product, we'll say so directly. Everything else we'll discuss on the call.
strings.faq.a18: Yes, we work all over Europe.
strings.faq.q19: I already have a website and a contractor. Is that a problem?
strings.faq.a19: No, that's great! We love meeting new people and we're sure we'll find common ground.
strings.faq.q20: Are photo and video shoots and editing included in SMM?
strings.faq.a20: Yes, they are. We also offer custom solutions.
